layers.name: ai-core

layers.name: runtime-not-tools
layers.why: shipped scripts must not depend on test or tool scripts (exports exclude tools/)

shared_why.scripts/fp/*.gd: S0 core: FpMode, FpContext, GameBus, FpFeature, the registry, world_scale (WS), asset_paths (AP), CityDirectory, RoadTopology
shared_why.scripts/fp/ui/hud_style.gd: B's palette and fonts; every on-foot panel draws with it
shared_why.scripts/fp/world/collision_world.gd: CollisionWorld.boxes() is an S0 shared contract (ARCHITECTURE.md §4)
shared_why.scripts/fp/render/quality.gd: G2's quality presets (Low/Medium/High) are read by the light profile and the pause menu

allow.why: slice C owns chatter_minds.gd (ARCHITECTURE.md §5) and shares its text helpers
chatter names real businesses through CityDirectory, an S0 shared contract
slice D owns gmi_image_client.gd (ARCHITECTURE.md §5); the worker and art helpers are D's
